baseline_note: Production V2: weights CCI/MACD/ADX = 0.10/0.10/0.80, tp3.5/sl1.5 ATR. Standalone realistic harness confirms live reality: H1 full PF 0.64, holdout PF 0.47, live-window PF 0.49 (real live 0.59). 0/4 positive folds on every TF. callpath_mismatches: mt5-bot.py get_signal() line ~643: `fn(I, i)` — NO hour, NO tf. When S00 is the regime PLAYBOOK primary on H1, sells are STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE (is_london_ny = hour is not None and ... -> False -> sell_thr stays 999) and the 7-22 UTC session filter is bypassed. Same class of bug as the known S16 `fn(I,i)` case.

mt5-bot.py StrategySelector H1 branch line ~1886: `fn_sel(I_h1, i_h1, hour=hour)` — passes hour but NOT tf. With tf=None the buy DI+ gate uses buy_di_min=20 (the M30 value) instead of 15 for H1 (signals.py line 181: `15 if tf in ('H1','H4') else 20`). Marginally stricter than intended on H1. Sells work here (hour passed).

mt5-bot.py H1-secondary loop line ~2041 and M30 loop line ~2422: BOTH pass `hour=hour, tf='H1'` / `tf='M30'` correctly — no mismatch. But REGIME_MULTI_STRATEGIES lists S00 ONLY as an M30 fallback (WEAK_UP/WEAK_DOWN/RANGE/UNKNOWN); the H1-secondary loop skips it (`if sec_tf != 'H1': continue`). So the only paths that actually reach S00 live are the M30 secondary loop (currently 100% blocked by quality_gate -> is_hard_blocked) and the StrategySelector H1/M30 branch.

strategy-engine-v2.py run_one() line ~1010: `fn(ind, i, hour=hour)` — NO tf for S00 (-> tf=None -> buy_di_min=20). run_adaptive() line ~1205 and run_adaptive_rm() line ~1336 DO pass `tf=tf`. So opt_harness.evaluate() (built on run_one) evaluates S00 with the stricter M30 DI gate even on H1, understating H1 buys by ~10-15%. My sweep works around this with force_tf in the factory; a 1-line fix to run_one (add `tf=tf` to the S00 branch, matching run_adaptive) is recommended and harmless.

TP/SL divergence across wiring points (all say 3.5/1.5 for V2 EXCEPT): strategy_selector.py STRATEGIES_CONFIG base_params was 3.5/1.0 (sl 1.0 vs 1.5 everywhere else — a pre-2026-04-30 leftover). risk_guardian STRATEGY_ATR_PARAMS, mt5-bot STRATEGY_PARAMS, strategy-engine run_one/run_adaptive/run_adaptive_rm all 3.5/1.5.

verdict: CONDITIONAL PROMOTE (probation), NOT 'retire'. The production V2 config is confirmed dead (holdout PF 0.47, 0/4 folds, matches -$2133 live). However a REDEFINED config — equal weights 0.33/0.33/0.34 (was ADX-dominant 0.80) + R:R 2.5/2.0 ATR (was 3.5/1.5), H1 only — passes is_promotable on the H1 holdout (PF 1.54, +$884, 3-4/4 folds), is robust (8/8 swept axes have 3/3 neighbour cells also beating baseline), turns the live window positive (PF 1.51-1.60 on 86-88 trades vs real 0.59), and lifts the whole adaptive+RM system (holdout PF 0.95->1.28). It stays < 1.0 on M30 (holdout 0.80) and marginal on H4 (holdout 1.03) so it must run H1-only. CAVEATS: this is a different strategy, not a tuned S00; found via ~150-combo mining (holdout multiple-comparison risk, mitigated but not zero); run_one BE/trailing sim is optimistic for a wide 2.0xATR stop. RECOMMENDATION: keep the hard_block OR set score_mult ~0.5, H1-only, and run a 4-6 week live probation with a PF>=1.2 / WR>=40% gate (S20 playbook). Do NOT restore score_mult 1.0 immediately. If live PF < 1.1 after 6 weeks -> retire S00 permanently.
